title: SYCL USM Asynchronous Barrier Event Dependency
prompt: Write a SYCL C++ snippet that asynchronously copies host buffer `h_weights` to device USM allocation `d_weights` using queue `q`, and immediately submits a compute kernel `process_weights` operating on `d_weights`. Ensure strict hardware event ordering so the kernel never reads uninitialized device memory, without stalling the host thread.
target_invariant: Must capture event from q.memcpy and declare h.depends_on(event) in kernel submission without calling host-stalling q.wait().
